steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: USA SLUS-00267 own NBA97 CUE/tracks; initial single-track CloneCD layout, others not assumed. Keep your original game files separately. The recorded source review did not download or run the game.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Probe own disc into local game.toml, build.ps1 generates boot/OpenBIOS C, run.ps1 launches native output. These are manual setup instructions. Portcove does not manage this download or confirm setup or gameplay.
